title: Flying Across the World

warmUp.question: Have you ever taken a long flight, and what did you do to pass the time?
warmUp.sampleAnswer: I watched two movies and slept for a few hours.

vocabulary.sentence: Show your passport at the desk.

sentenceFrames: Could you show me your ____, please?
The ____ was longer than I expected.

pages.heading: The Longest Layover
pages.text: Nadia checks the departure board. Her flight is delayed by four hours, so she misses her connection.

pages.heading: Landing at Last
pages.text: After turbulence and a long queue at customs, Nadia finally collects her suitcase.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why does Nadia miss her connection?
comprehensionQuestions.sampleAnswer: Her first flight is delayed by four hours.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What happens after she lands?
comprehensionQuestions.sampleAnswer: She waits at customs and collects her suitcase.

creativeQuestions.question: What would you pack for a very long flight?
creativeQuestions.sampleAnswer: I would pack a book, snacks, and headphones.

speakingQuestions.question: How do you feel about flying?
speakingQuestions.sampleAnswer: I like it, but turbulence makes me nervous.

speakingQuestions.question: What is the longest trip you have taken?
speakingQuestions.sampleAnswer: I flew for twelve hours to visit my family.

speakingQuestions.question: How do you deal with jet lag?
speakingQuestions.sampleAnswer: I try to sleep at the new local time.

speakingQuestions.question: What do you always keep in your hand luggage?
speakingQuestions.sampleAnswer: My passport, my phone, and a charger.

activity.title: Airport Announcement Role Play
activity.prompt: Read the delayed flight announcement and help your partner find the right gate.

reviewSentences: Our flight was delayed, so we missed the connection.
Please keep your passport and boarding pass ready.
After customs we collected our suitcases.
